models.title: ResNet-18
models.scope: 224×224 input, four stages of two BasicBlocks; stage outputs shown. Stem includes Conv/BN/ReLU/MaxPool. Block internals are expanded separately.

models.title: MobileNetV2 1.0
models.scope: 224 input and width multiplier1.0. Each stage groups repeated inverted residual blocks; internal expansion and depthwise steps have their own module diagram.

models.title: ViT-B/16
models.scope: 224 input,16-pixel patches:196 patch tokens plus one class token.12 encoder blocks with D768. Positional embedding and class-token insertion grouped explicitly; token axes are not image spatial dimensions.

models.title: Swin-T
models.scope: 224 input,patch4,window7,stage depths2/2/6/2. Patch merging is a distinct operation. Layer norms and final pooling/classifier are grouped.

models.title: U-Net · original valid-padding
models.scope: Original572 input and388 output; valid3×3 convolutions. Each encoder stage includes the following pooling operation only on outgoing main paths; skip edges include crop. Decoder stages group up-conv, crop-concat and double-conv.

models.title: DeepLabv3+
models.scope: Output stride16 schematic. ASPP internals have a separate module view. Low-level features are projected to48 channels; encoder features are upsampled4× before concat, then refined and upsampled4×.

models.title: SegFormer-B0
models.scope: Four MiT-B0 output levels32/64/160/256. Each decoder projection maps to256 and resizes to1/4. Fusion concat is1024 channels before1×1 fusion and prediction. Final resize shown; encoder internals omitted.

models.title: DETR
models.scope: Inference architecture: CNN features+position feed encoder; learned object queries feed decoder. Class and box heads operate in parallel. Bipartite matching loss is a training objective and is omitted.

models.title: Segment Anything · SAM
models.scope: SAM1 inference macro view: image encoder, sparse/dense prompt encoder, mask decoder, mask outputs and quality scores. Prompt types are grouped; automatic mask generation is not an extra neural stage.

models.title: UNetFormer
models.scope: ResNet18 encoder and64-channel decoder. Three global-local blocks at1/32,1/16,1/8; weighted fusion includes upsampling. Feature-refinement head uses1/4 skip; auxiliary training head omitted.

models.title: BIT · bitemporal transformer
models.locator: BASE_Transformer.forward; semantic tokenizer and transformer decoder
models.scope: Shared backbone extracts both dates. Joint transformer encodes concatenated semantic tokens, which split by date for two decoder calls. Feature bypasses are preserved. Absolute differencing, upsampling and CNN classification follow.

models.title: ChangeFormer · Siamese overview
models.locator: Siamese Transformer encoder and multiscale decoder; §3 in IGARSS2022 paper
models.scope: Macro overview shared across the family: two shared hierarchical encoders, multiscale difference modules and lightweight decoder. Exact layer counts/interpolation/upsampling differ by code variant; no numeric variant-specific dimensions are asserted.

models.title: CLIP · contrastive pretraining
models.scope: Training representation view: paired image/text encoders produce normalized embeddings and an all-pairs similarity matrix. Symmetric contrastive objective shown as a distinct endpoint; this is not a single-image segmentation pipeline.

models.title: Residual BasicBlock
models.scope: Stride1, matching-channel identity path. Downsampling projection is not used in this particular block.

models.title: Inverted residual · stride1
models.scope: Expansion factor t, depthwise spatial filtering, linear projection. Identity is shown only for stride1 and equal input/output channels.

models.title: ViT encoder block
models.scope: Pre-normalization Transformer block with two residual additions. MLP groups Dense/GELU/Dense; dropout omitted.

models.title: Swin block pair
models.scope: One window-attention block followed by a shifted-window block. Each macro block includes pre-norm, attention residual and MLP residual. No patch merge inside this pair.

models.title: ASPP · output stride16
models.scope: Five parallel branches:1×1, three atrous3×3 at rates6/12/18, image pooling with projection+resize. Concatenation followed by1×1 projection. Branch internals folded into labeled volumes.

models.title: SegFormer All-MLP decoder
models.scope: Four feature levels are linearly embedded and aligned to the finest stride. Concatenation and1×1 fusion precede class prediction. Decoder embedding width is configurable.

models.title: Squeeze-and-Excitation
models.scope: Global average pooling; two fully connected layers with reduction r; ReLU then sigmoid; channelwise multiplication broadcasts over H/W.

models.title: CBAM · sequential attention
models.scope: Channel attention followed by spatial attention; both maps gate their current features. Pool/MLP and spatial7×7 details are grouped inside the named attention modules.

models.title: UNetFormer global-local attention
models.scope: Local1×1+3×3 features are added to window attention with cross-shaped pooling, then projected by separable convolution. Norm/MLP and outer GLTB residuals are outside this inner attention view.

models.title: BIT semantic tokenizer
models.scope: A learned1×1 projection creates L spatial attention maps; softmax is over flattened spatial positions. Weighted aggregation of the original features produces L×C tokens.

models.title: Siamese feature differencing
models.scope: Shared feature extraction and absolute elementwise difference; head and interpolation details stay model-specific. Two backbone invocations share weights, not input tensors.

models.title: UNetFormer feature-refinement head
models.scope: Upsampling and normalized weighted skip fusion precede post-convolution. Channel/spatial attention branches gate x; their results add, project and combine with a shortcut before activation.

models.title: STANet · official-code PAM
models.locator: Pinned author code and paper doi:10.3390/rs12101662, Fig.2 and §2.1
models.scope: Pinned official CDFA/mynet3/PAM code, f_c64,ds1. Code computes distance before interpolation; PAM has no residual addition, unlike the paper figure. Example256 input; training BCL omitted.

models.title: STANet pyramid-attention module
models.locator: Pinned author code and paper doi:10.3390/rs12101662, Fig.2 and §2.1
models.scope: Pinned PAM2.py code: four regional scales1/2/4/8, concatenation and1×1 projection. No X+Y residual in this code variant.

models.title: STANet shared feature extractor
models.locator: Pinned author code and paper doi:10.3390/rs12101662, Fig.2 and §2.1
models.scope: Pinned mynet3 code uses BasicBlock depths2/2/2/3 and final dilation multipliers1/2/4. Four96-channel projections align and concatenate in order stage4,stage1,stage2,stage3.
